analysis:
The PR changes only docs/developer/build.md (head lines 439-448). It bumps the pinned darkbloom-sandbox watchdog commit reference from 31236c54 to d6d257c2, and it rewrites the watchdog description. Staleness is now timed from the job's own creation. Other Darkbloom jobs of the run that ran or still run no longer hold back a rescue, so a run with one stranded shard is rescued. The doc also warns that jobs waiting at the payer's concurrency limit look stranded and says to set DARKBLOOM_WATCHDOG_MINUTES above such waits.

This is documentation only. It touches no provider code, no coordinator-provider WebSocket contract, no key custody, no attestation or App Attest authorization, no prefix cache (T-041), no fan helper and no sandbox installer.

The watchdog is CI-only. The doc says its token has only actions:write and checks:write, that it re-runs only routed workflows, and that release and signing runs carry literal Blacksmith labels and are never touched. The edit does not alter those claims. No threat IDs are invalidated, and the change reads as consistent with the existing threat model.

One unverified item: the actual watchdog workflow file (.github/workflows/darkbloom-watchdog.yml) is not in the supplied evidence. Whether it matches the described behavior and the new pin, and whether the 'copied unchanged' claim holds, would need a check of that file in a separate pass. This is a documentation-accuracy question and not a demonstrated security regression, so I record no finding.
